name: RRSOS PCC Auto Fill
description: Label a storage crate (Container1, 2 or 3) with an item's name - its id, its name in the game, or one of its extra names such as O2 - and the crate's empty slots are filled with that item. Only at a rename, whole-name matches only, and what is in the crate already stays.

commands.name: /addname
commands.help: give an item another name for crate labels

terminalCommands.name: /resupply
terminalCommands.help: top up every labelled crate (needs the Commands mod's terminal)
